name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura Interview preparation and reference links for canonical destinations duplicates and stale material. Use when maintaining or releasing the interview-preparation index. Do not use when judging the quality of a candidate response or interview question.

# Link audit

- Check links in changed interview-preparation sections.
- Prefer canonical documentation employer-neutral resources or original publishers.
- Detect duplicate destinations and redundant preparation resources.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete references.
- Preserve historical material only when its role is explicit.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
